name: Pattoki

queries.query: Pattoki Pakistan official cadastral parcel map GIS land records Punjab
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA), the Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement (PULSE) project, and official Punjab GIS/API hosts. PLRA describes electronic/GIS-linked land records; PULSE describes parcel mapping linked to land records. No Pattoki-specific public parcel polygon service was established.

queries.query: پتوکی پاکستان سرکاری کادسٹرل نقشہ اراضی ریکارڈ GIS
queries.result: Urdu-language discovery returned the same first-party Punjab land-record and parcel-mapping services, including PLRA's Urdu terminology and PULSE parcel-mapping material. No safe anonymous Pattoki parcel ID plus full polygon response was qualified.

registryEvidence.basis: A first-party provincial land-record custodian and parcel-mapping program are evidenced, and the current PLRA JavaScript exposes official GIS/API hosts. This establishes registry/service evidence, not a verified Pattoki parcel geometry feed.

officialSources.observation: Official PLRA site identifies Punjab Land Records Authority and says land records are digitized/GIS-linked; the viewer shell is a JavaScript application.
Official PULSE project site describes a unified Punjab land information system and provision of parcel maps linked to land records.
Official PLRA GIS ArcGIS REST directory responded anonymously and listed service folders, but no Pattoki/Kasur parcel feature service was exposed in the directory response.

requests.outcome: TLS-verified PLRA application shell fetched; current JavaScript bundle was inspected.

TLS-verified current bundle exposed official hosts gismaps.punjab-zameen.gov.pk/arcgis, production-api.pulse.gop.pk/api, geo-token.pulse.gop.pk/api/token/generate, and the Kasur/Pattoki service-center hierarchy. No parcel query route with safe geometry was identified.
Anonymous ArcGIS REST root returned folders including PULSE_LMKR and Punjab, plus ArcGIS_Shell and SampleWorldCities services; no Pattoki/Kasur parcel feature service was listed.
Anonymous folder inspection returned an empty service list.

TLS-verified PULSE project page fetched; project scope and parcel-map objective were recorded, but the portal did not expose a directly usable anonymous Pattoki polygon response in this attempt.
